boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Saint Vincent College
boards.description: Current, under-21-safe food options in Latrobe with directly verified evening hours. Confirm availability before leaving, especially for drive-thru and weekend service.

cards.title: McDonald's at Mount Laurel Plaza
cards.subtitle: 110 Mount Laurel Plaza, Latrobe
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru when an evening meal is needed; the official location page lists daily drive-thru service until 11 PM.
cards.short_summary: A daily 11 PM drive-thru option in Mount Laurel Plaza.
cards.evidence_claim: McDonald's lists drive-thru hours of 5 AM–11 PM every day at 110 Mount Laurel Plaza in Latrobe.
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru is listed daily until 11 PM; lobby hours are listed until 10 PM.

cards.title: Eat'n Park Latrobe
cards.subtitle: 1026 Mountain Laurel Plaza, Latrobe
cards.notes: Choose dine-in, pickup-window, or delivery service for a full-menu stop; check the location page before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A restaurant option listed open until 11 PM every day.
cards.evidence_claim: Eat'n Park lists its Latrobe restaurant at 1026 Mountain Laurel Plaza as open 7 AM–11 PM daily.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists daily hours of 7 AM–11 PM and pickup-window service.

cards.title: Taco Bell at Mountain Laurel Plaza
cards.subtitle: 1022 Mountain Laurel Plaza, Latrobe
cards.notes: Plan on drive-thru service for the latest window; the official listing separates drive-thru hours from earlier dine-in hours.
cards.short_summary: Drive-thru service runs as late as 3 AM on Fridays and Saturdays.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists drive-thru hours until 2 AM Sunday–Thursday and 3 AM Friday–Saturday at 1022 Mountain Laurel Plaza.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell — 1022 Mountain Laurel Plaza, Latrobe
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru is listed until 2 AM most nights and 3 AM Friday–Saturday; dine-in closes earlier.

cards.title: Wendy's at Latrobe Thirty Plaza
cards.subtitle: 10 Latrobe Thirty Plaza, Latrobe
cards.notes: Use restaurant or drive-thru service for a late meal; both sets of official hours run to midnight every day.
cards.short_summary: A midnight option with restaurant and drive-thru service.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy's lists restaurant and drive-thru hours of 6:30 AM–12 AM daily at 10 Latrobe Thirty Plaza.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists both restaurant and drive-thru open until 12 AM daily.

cards.title: Papa Johns Pizza on Colony Lane
cards.subtitle: 205 Colony Lane, Latrobe
cards.notes: Place a carryout or delivery order through the store page and allow extra time near the listed closing time.
cards.short_summary: Carryout and delivery are listed until midnight on Fridays and Saturdays.
cards.evidence_claim: Papa Johns lists carryout and delivery until 11 PM Sunday–Thursday and 12 AM Friday–Saturday at 205 Colony Lane.
cards.source_title: Papa Johns Pizza — 205 Colony Lane, Latrobe
cards.access_notes: Carryout and delivery are listed until 11 PM most nights and midnight Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: Domino's on Route 30
cards.subtitle: 3960 Route 30, Suite 102, Latrobe
cards.notes: Use the official store page to order delivery or carryout; it identifies this Route 30 location as open until midnight.
cards.short_summary: A Route 30 pizza stop listed open until midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Domino's official Latrobe store page lists 3960 Route 30, Suite 102 and states it is open until 12 AM.
cards.access_notes: Official store page lists the location as open until 12 AM; use its order flow for current service availability.

cards.title: KFC at Latrobe Thirty Plaza
cards.subtitle: 1004 Latrobe Thirty Plaza, Latrobe
cards.notes: Use carryout, delivery, or drive-thru for an evening order; the official location listing posts a 10:30 PM close every day.
cards.evidence_claim: KFC lists its 1004 Latrobe Thirty Plaza location as open 10:30 AM–10:30 PM daily.
cards.access_notes: Official listing gives daily hours of 10:30 AM–10:30 PM and names carryout, delivery, and drive-thru.

cards.title: Pitstop Pizza & Subs
cards.subtitle: 1703 Ligonier Street, Latrobe
cards.notes: Call ahead or use online ordering for slices, pizza, and subs; Friday and Saturday hours extend through 10 PM.
cards.short_summary: A downtown-adjacent pizza counter with 10 PM weekend hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Pitstop Pizza & Subs lists Friday–Saturday hours of 11 AM–10 PM at 1703 Ligonier Street.
cards.source_title: Pitstop Pizza & Subs — Menu and Hours
cards.access_notes: Official site lists Friday–Saturday service until 10 PM; Monday–Thursday closes at 9 PM and Sunday at 8 PM.

cards.title: Denny's on Route 30 West
cards.subtitle: 3870 US State Route 30 West, Latrobe
cards.notes: Use the official restaurant page for dine-in, pickup, or delivery and check its live ordering status before traveling.
cards.short_summary: An all-day-breakfast location whose official page says it serves food 24/7.
cards.evidence_claim: Denny's official page for 3870 US State Route 30 West says the Latrobe restaurant serves all-day breakfast and food 24/7.
cards.source_title: Denny's — 3870 US State Route 30 West, Latrobe
cards.access_notes: The official page states it serves food 24/7, while its ordering-status display can vary; confirm current service before leaving.

cards.title: Jioio's Family Restaurant
cards.subtitle: 6067 Route 981, Latrobe
cards.notes: Use this Route 981 restaurant for an early-evening pizza or Italian-food order; Friday and Saturday hours are listed until 9 PM.
cards.short_summary: A family restaurant with 9 PM Friday and Saturday closing hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Jioio's lists Friday and Saturday hours of 2 PM–9 PM at its 6067 Route 981 Latrobe restaurant.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists Friday–Saturday service until 9 PM; Sunday closes at 8 PM and Monday–Thursday at 8 PM.
